opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward a paid mining and membership opportunity built around OneCoin. It asks how to profit by joining mining, explains that members use OneTokens to secure places in mining pools, and ties the number of available slots to the package purchased. It further describes users joining a mining pool that receives rewards in OneCoins, while displaying the promotional message “Profit with OneCoin.” The speaker also refers to participants reaching the maximum of a compensation plan each week, reinforcing the network-marketing structure. Although the presentation cautions that values fluctuate and prices should not skyrocket, its central message remains an invitation to participate through mining packages and network membership for anticipated profit.
